change_log.value: Explainability Fallback and Missing Data Handling
change_log.note: Add resilience handling for incomplete signals

EVAL-F5-S59.title: Explainability API Response Contract Exposure
EVAL-F5-S59.description: Define and expose the explainability schema in FastAPI response models to ensure all evaluation endpoints consistently return source, meaning, and limitations fields in a machine-readable format.

EVAL-F5-S60.title: Frontend Rendering of Explainability Metadata
EVAL-F5-S60.description: Update MessageBubble and ChatWindow components to render explainability metadata (source, meaning, limitations) alongside evaluation results in a user-friendly format with clear attribution and readability.

EVAL-F5-S61.title: Explainability Fallback and Missing Data Handling
EVAL-F5-S61.description: Implement logic to handle missing or partial explainability fields by providing default messaging (e.g., 'Source not available') and ensuring no evaluation response is returned without a complete explainability structure.
